//: Project-scoped MCP servers for the Tap repo. Auto-loaded by Claude Code when this directory is opened. Each contributor is prompted once to approve the server before it runs.

mcpServers.//: Context7 surfaces up-to-date docs + code snippets for any library indexed at context7.com. Used here so the Mantine v9 skill can fetch authoritative prop signatures + examples on demand. No API key needed.
mcpServers.//2: Dogfoods this repo's own `tap-studio mcp` stdio server against the sample workspace: workspace_inventory / describe_request / send_request / call_request / run_test as tools, secrets redacted. Same engine as the CLI.
mcpServers.//3: The other product's agent surface: `tap mcp` reads a running inspector's captured traffic, redacted. It takes no arguments — it finds the inspector via the handle at ~/.tap/inspector/<uiPort>.json and authenticates with that run's token. Tools do nothing until an inspector is running with Inspector__Agent__Enabled=true (or .WithAgentAccess() in an AppHost).
